context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 寸法/鉢/悩ま/こぼし/とかし/しり/ふる/低かっ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、新しいランドセル、寸法、ぴったりだったよ。
lines.en: Mom, my new backpack fits just right.
lines.style: Bright and eager. Quick opening, words tumbling over each other. Sho wants to share something good. No self-consciousness — pure six-year-old pride.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃんが、お花の鉢、持ってきてくれたよ。
lines.en: That's nice. Grandma brought over some flowers in a pot.
lines.style: Warm, present attention. A soft smile in the voice. She's listening fully, building on what he said. Gentle and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、宿題で悩まされてるんだ、最近。
lines.en: I've been really struggling with homework lately.
lines.style: Quieter than before. A small complaint, not performed for sympathy — genuine worry he's letting slip. Slight downturn at the end. He's testing whether it's safe to admit being stuck.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お味噌汁、こぼしちゃダメよ、翔くん。
lines.en: Don't spill your miso soup, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle redirection, not scolding. A practical mother's half-attention while watching him eat. Tone shifts into caretaking — present but matter-of-fact. The weight of small daily care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 髪、ちゃんととかしたよ、ぼく、自分で。
lines.en: I combed my hair all by myself today.
lines.style: Bright comeback after the correction. He's offering this as evidence of competence, maybe to shift attention. Quick tempo. The eagerness to show growth and capability.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達と、しりとり、楽しかった?
lines.en: Did you have fun playing shiritori with your friend?
lines.style: Curious, gentle prompt. She's noticing his afternoon, drawing him back into conversation. No interrogation — just interested. Warm and open.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 雨がふる前に、お家、帰りたいね、ママ。
lines.en: Mom, can we head home before it rains?
lines.style: Slight urgency, but not panicked. A small boy's practical worry. He's thought ahead and wants to fix it. Quick, a little breathless — wanting to move.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 去年、翔くんの身長、まだ低かったわね、今年、伸びたわ。
lines.en: You know, Sho, you were so much shorter just last year. Look how much you've grown.
lines.style: Soft, almost marveling. The voice of a mother noticing time passing in her child's body. Slightly tender, slightly wistful. The trailing-off holds quiet love.
